For CSS, I'll style everything nicely with Mario Kart theming. For JS, I'll implement the core game loop with physics, collision detection, item mechanics, and AI opponents. Let me create a comprehensive implementation: The track will be an oval circuit. Players control their karts with W/S for accelerate/brake, A/D for steering left/right. There'll be AI competitors, power-ups (green shells, red shells, bananas), and lap tracking. I'll use requestAnimationFrame for the game loop and canvas for rendering.
